activity_items.desc:
16 pickleball courts are set up for games to be played on a rotation basis using the paddle stacking system to queue into games.

Players should know the rules of the game and have basic knowledge of techniques. There will be a designated court for Beginners/Advanced Beginners (look for sign on net).

Players must check in when entering the court.
Only registered players are allowed on the court.
Player minimum age is 12 years old.
Players provide their own paddle and balls.
Some loaner paddles may be available.
Players must follow general court rules.

Court 4 will have designated Challenge nets.
Advanced/4.0+ (north side) has 2 nets.
Intermediate/3.25-3.75 (south side) has 2 nets.

Sessions are held Mondays through Thursdays, 5:00 - 9:30pm; Saturdays and Sundays have a morning session at 8 to 11am and a midday session at 11:15am to 2pm (all players will be asked to leave the courts between sessions). Registrants may arrive and leave within the listed time period.

NO REFUNDS. When rain cancels participants will receive a refund and be notified by email / text.
